_readme: Room and furniture geometry, plus the registries that rooms.json is checked against.
anchors  — where furniture sits, as % of the room. A room can hold at most this
many containers, so adding a 7th container to a room in rooms.json
means adding a 7th anchor here first.
'rect' is for square rooms, 'soft' is pulled inward for round/hex rooms.
kinds    — the furniture skins. Each must have a matching .k-<id> rule in
css/furniture.css. w/h override defaultSize for that kind.
floors   — the floor patterns. Each must have a matching .floor-<id> rule in css/room.css.
tokens   — the non-sortable items: keys, coins. These must NOT appear in rooms.json.
pads     — keep-out margins around furniture when scattering items, in room %.
Bigger pads = items land further from furniture.
